title: CSV/JSON exports and management summaries
description: Export assets, relationships, services, ports, and dashboard summaries
spec:
1. Export assets, relationship lists, services, ports, and dashboard summaries to CSV and JSON.
2. Provide printable/exportable management summaries.
3. Provide audit-friendly reports for changes, ownership gaps, exposed ports, and lifecycle status.
4. Verify exports contain correct, permission-filtered data.
